narrative.overview: The interface reads like airport and rail wayfinding. Surfaces are flat panels cut from a warm palette, ember orange, ink, paper and sage with stone as the inset, each held by a 2px ink edge. Nothing floats and nothing blurs. Type is one family, Overpass, set at Black weight and tight leading for anything that names a place, a price or a count. Meaning travels by shape before colour: a state is a solid, dashed or struck outline, a connector is an arrow, a kind of space is a drawn pictogram.
keyCharacteristics: Five palette names only: ember, sage, paper, stone, ink. There is no white surface.
Fields are full-bleed and separated by a 2px ink rule; every panel carries a 2px ink edge.
Overpass Variable throughout; Black (900) set solid for display and numerals.
State by outline shape: solid, dashed, struck.
Authored SVG pictograms and a solid arrow replace icon libraries.

rules.name: The Panel Is The Pairing Rule
rules.body: Ember and sage panels carry ink text and ink 2px edges; ink panels carry paper text; paper and stone carry ink, muted or subtle ink. Controls on orange take a paper fill with ink text and an ink edge.

rules.name: The Ember Text Rule
rules.body: Ember is text only on ink and only at 18px bold or larger (4.81:1). Never ember text on paper, stone or sage.

rules.name: The No Muted On Colour Rule
rules.body: fg-muted and fg-subtle never sit on ember or sage.

rules.name: The Danger Rule
rules.body: Danger crimson (#9B1C2E) text and destructive buttons never sit on an orange panel; state stays carried by shape.

rules.name: The No White Rule
rules.body: White is not in the palette; every light surface is paper or stone.

rules.name: The Sage Sparingly Rule
rules.body: Sage is background only, used for the co-living field, the testimonial field and the hero facts list, and never as a bare block without an ink panel or paper card on it.

rules.name: The Solid Setting Rule
rules.body: Anything that names a place, price or count is Black weight with leading at or below 1.05 and tracking -0.03em.

rules.name: The Tabular Number Rule
rules.body: Prices, night counts and stat figures use tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: A raised surface is a paper or coloured panel with a 2px ink edge. Hover changes fill, never adds a shadow.

dos: Do separate sections with full-bleed colour fields and a 2px ink rule.
Do put ink text and ink edges on ember and sage; put paper-filled controls on orange.
Do use ember as text only on ink and only at 18px bold or larger.
Do carry state by outline shape (solid, dashed, struck) as well as colour.
Do set places, prices and counts in Black weight, solid leading, tabular numerals.
Do use the authored Pictogram and Arrow components for kind-of-space and connection; add glyphs to the same 32 grid.
Do keep every focus ring two-layer: ink outline with paper gap, flipped to paper outline with ink gap on ink fields.
Do write user-facing strings through t().
donts: Don't use fg-muted or fg-subtle on ember or sage.
Don't put danger text or destructive buttons on an orange panel.
Don't introduce a white surface, a sixth palette colour or colour-only status.
Don't use sage as text or a line, or as a bare block with nothing on it.
Don't put ember text on paper, stone or sage.
Don't add blur shadows, gradients, rounded pills or glass; radii stay 0 to 4px.
Don't use icon fonts or third-party icon sets for wayfinding glyphs.
